correctness.rationale: All symbols and quantifiers are explicit. At depth t every subsequence is constant, so the max is the k-ary tree node count; the period word with distinct output letters attains it. A depth-(t-1) nonconstant ancestor chain gives t pairwise distinct nonconstant elements, since any repeat yields a nonconstant cycle reaching arbitrary depth, plus two distinct constant states. For interleaving, the isolated nonzero output fixes residue mod k and enforces exact period k^t, and disjoint nonzero child alphabets imply exact rank 2+sum(q_j-1). Base t=1 covers 3..k+1, binary (2,2) covers 4..7 by explicit words, and remaining cases have overlapping induction intervals since B_(t-1)>=2t. Unsharing zeros in k maximal children fills the last k-1 values. The provided verifier independently checks 168 constructed examples and 25,285 primitive partition patterns; no infinite fact depends on extrapolation.
